$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFDA (AIP France, chart dated 2025-01-23): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Aire-sur-l'Adour

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked

preferredQfuReason: preferred QFU 115, due to longer LDA
notes: Simultaneous use of both RWY prohibited.
Unpaved RWY reserved for gliders, home-based ACFT or ACFT authorized by AD operator.
Unpaved RWY not available after heavy rain: glider activity is transferred to paved RWY.
Preferred QFU: 115°, due to longer LDA.
Taxiing prohibited except on RWY and TWY.
Gliders winching activity (NR 973) announced on A/A frequency and by yellow rotating light on the winch, SFC / 2000 ft AMSL, SR-SS, non marked cable.
Arrival over the airfield at minimum 2500 ft AMSL minimum.
Take-off and landing forbidden during winching take-off procedure.
